formio-actions/SKILL.md: Configure Form.io actions — the server-side layer for email notifications, login, webhooks, role assignment, and form-to-form saves: types, settings, handler/method, priorities, conditions. Use when the user wants to add, configure, or troubleshoot an action on a form, even without saying "action": "send an email when someone submits", "add login to this form", "assign a role after registration", "call a webhook on update". Not for: SSO, Token Swap, Custom JWT, sessions, 2FA, or RBAC (see `formio-auth`); REST endpoint lookups (see `formio-api`); the UAG's "Agent: Run task" action (see `formio-uag`).
formio-angular/SKILL.md: Angular implementor: build or extend an Angular app around a Form.io project with `@formio/angular` (setup, bootstrap, config, auth, resources), or embed one form in an Angular page. Claims only Angular-named requests. Use when the user says "build it in Angular", "Angular front-end for this Form.io project", "use `@formio/angular`", "wire up `FormioAppConfig`", "embed a Form.io form in Angular", or "render a form in my Angular app". Not for: a new app whose data model is not yet planned, Angular-named or not (see `formio-application`); framework-agnostic embedding (see `formio-form`); planning a data model (see `formio-resource-planner`); React work (see `formio-react`).
formio-angular/formio-angular-resources/: Angular-only sub-skill: adds, regenerates, or repairs one resource NgModule in an Angular workspace whose `AppModule` already wires `FormioAppConfig`. Reached from `formio-angular`, or by phrasing that names Angular: "add an Angular module for X", "regenerate the Angular `Participant` resource module", "in my Angular app, wire `X`'s children to `Y`". Not for: creating the Angular app or wiring `FormioAppConfig` (see `formio-angular`); extension requests that never name Angular (see `formio-application`); data modelling alone (see `formio-resource-planner`).
formio-api/SKILL.md: Form.io REST API reference — every endpoint across platform admin, project admin, runtime (end-user), and PDF scopes. Use when the user asks to call, script, inspect, or document a Form.io REST endpoint — projects, stages, teams, forms, revisions, actions, roles, registration and login, submissions, reports, PDFs, status — or about the `x-jwt-token` header and base URL vs project URL. Not for: building an app (see `formio-application`); planning a data model (see `formio-resource-planner`); Form.io JSON schemas (see `formio-schema`); the JavaScript SDK — `Formio.*`, `new Formio(...)`, `Utils.*` (see `formio-sdk`).
formio-application/SKILL.md: Default "build me an app" orchestrator — builds a Form.io-backed app from a plain-language idea, or extends one with a feature. Use when the user wants to build, create, or spin up an app, tool, portal, dashboard, or tracker around data — "build me an app", "create a CRM", "task manager", "help desk", or a new app naming a framework ("build me a CRM in React") — or extend one, even in an Angular or React workspace: "also track X", "add a way to see Y". Not for: Angular- or React-named requests, whether for an imported project or an existing workspace in that framework (see `formio-angular` / `formio-react`); planning a data model only (see `formio-resource-planner`); embedding an existing form (see `formio-form`); a standalone single form (see `formio-form-builder`).
formio-auth/SKILL.md: Form.io authentication and authorization — resource-backed login, roles and RBAC, group permissions, SSO (OIDC, OAuth, SAML, LDAP) with role mapping, Token Swap, Custom JWT, email-token auth (magic links, password reset), and JWT/session mechanics (`x-jwt-token`, logout, 2FA, reCAPTCHA). Use when the user asks to configure how users sign in or what they may do — SSO, OIDC, SAML, LDAP, Token Swap, Custom JWT, passwordless auth, password reset, sessions, roles, permissions, RBAC, group permissions, 2FA, or reCAPTCHA. Not for: designing the data model (see `formio-resource-planner`); building an app (see `formio-application`); adding a Login or Role Assignment action to one form (see `formio-actions`).
formio-form-builder/SKILL.md: Default "build me a form" orchestrator — builds one Form.io form end to end (webform, wizard, or PDF form) and saves it via the MCP server, optionally handing off to embedding. Use when the user asks to "build a form", "create a form", make a "multi-page form", a "survey", "contact form", "intake form", "registration form", "questionnaire", or "pdf form", or to edit an existing form: "add a phone field to my registration form". Boundary: "build a form to collect X" is this skill; "track X / manage X" (a data model) is `formio-application`. Not for: embedding an existing form (see `formio-form`); building an app (see `formio-application`); designing resources (see `formio-resource-planner`); raw schema lookups (see `formio-schema`); REST endpoints (see `formio-api`).
formio-form/SKILL.md: Embed and render Form.io forms in any web app with the `@formio/js` renderer — by URL or JSON, pre-filled, controlled from JavaScript — and own field behavior: conditionals, calculated values, JSON Logic validation, cascading selects. The default "embed a form" entry point. Use when the user asks to "embed a form", "render a form", "add this form to my page", "pre-fill a form", "show or hide a field based on another field", "calculate a field value", "add custom validation to a field", or add conditional wizard pages — field behavior in ANY framework's form stays here. Not for: Angular (see `formio-angular`) or React-named (see `formio-react`) embedding; building an app (see `formio-application`) or its data model (see `formio-resource-planner`); REST endpoints (see `formio-api`); the raw SDK (see `formio-sdk`); creating a new form (see `formio-form-builder`); agent-filled forms or chats (see `formio-uag`).
formio-mcp-setup/SKILL.md: Connects the Form.io MCP server (`@formio/mcp`) to the running coding agent — Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, or Codex — so the Form.io skills have tools to call, then records which Form.io project this directory uses. Use when a Form.io skill finds the MCP tools missing, when no Form.io tools are available, or when the user asks to install, connect, configure, or fix the Form.io MCP server. Not for: logging in to Form.io — the server opens that in the browser on the first tool call; an application's end-user auth (see `formio-auth`); building anything with Form.io — return to the skill that sent you here.
formio-resource-planner/SKILL.md: Plans a Form.io application's resources, fields, and access model, then emits a ready-to-import `template.json` — a Resource Map for approval, then the full template of roles, resources, forms, and actions. Interview-driven. Use when the user asks to design, model, or plan the resources, schema, data model, or permissions — "design the resources for...", "plan the schema for...", "model <domain> in Form.io". Not for: building the app itself — "build me a task manager" (see `formio-application`, which runs this planner); one standalone form (see `formio-form-builder`); SSO, Custom JWT, 2FA, or RBAC tuning beyond default roles (see `formio-auth`).
formio-schema/SKILL.md: Form.io JSON schema reference — the shapes of projects, forms and resources, and submissions. Use when constructing, editing, or interpreting Form.io JSON: form definitions from `form_get` / `form_create` / `form_update`, components (textfield, select, datagrid, panel), wizards, conditional logic, validation, submission bodies (`data`, `access`, `metadata`), and project templates for `project_import` / `project_export`. Not for: REST endpoints (see `formio-api`); server-side actions (see `formio-actions`); planning a new app's resources (see `formio-resource-planner`); orchestrating an app build (see `formio-application`).
formio-sdk/SKILL.md: Source-derived reference for the Form.io JavaScript SDK (`@formio/js`) and its Utilities (`@formio/js/utils`): `Formio.*` statics (`setBaseUrl`, `setProjectUrl`, `setToken`, `currentUser`, `logout`), `new Formio(url)` instances, `Formio.createForm`, plugins, and `Utils` (Evaluator, traversal, conditions, JSONLogic, mask/sanitize). Use when the user asks to call a `Formio.*` method, use a `new Formio(...)` instance, invoke a `Utils.*` helper, evaluate JSONLogic, register a plugin, or decode the JWT. Not for: REST endpoints (see `formio-api`); app builds (see `formio-application`); `@formio/angular` wrappers (see `formio-angular`); embedding a form (see `formio-form`).
